[1mDescription[22m:
Record performance trace on device

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli perf trace record[22m [options]

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m-p, --pbtx <name|path>[22m    PBTX preset name (default) or path to custom .pbtx
                            file (default: "default")
  [1m--adb <path>[22m              Path to adb executable (optional, overrides
                            ADB_PATH/PROFILER_ADB/PATH)
  [1m-d, --device <id>[22m         Target device ID
  [1m-a, --package <package>[22m
